profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Fanatics Betting & Gaming

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
Sabbatical from work during the COVID-19 pandemic
- Worked on artistic pursuits related to music and electronics
- Co-founded a DJ streaming group which raised in excess of $10,000 for various charities
- Professional development on the latest evolutions in software engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Technical lead of a software engineering team that further developed the Mister Kraken software used by producers & processors of the Washington I-502 industry

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Enabling producers and processors of the Washington I-502 industry to efficiently comply with traceability regulations, as well as helping their business grow with analytics and sales tools.
Acquired by Treez Inc. in 2018
